long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Aerbin village near Dalian, Zhao left school as a teenager and learned masonry on construction sites before moving into management beside his father. During the group's restructuring and later share transfers, he became its controlling shareholder. Under his leadership, it won five Luban construction awards and developed an integrated model spanning building, property development, hotels and commercial-property operations.

Football became Zhao's most visible public project. A lifelong follower of the sport, he built a professional club around Dalian's deep football tradition and invested in training facilities and youth development as well as the senior team. The venture carried a new side to the top division in two seasons. Although the club changed ownership in 2015, Zhao remained identified with that rapid ascent and with the attempt to rebuild the city's football standing.
